title.zh: Ritual 主网上线，原生代币 RITUAL 同步推出并登陆 Coinbase
title.en: Ritual 主网上线，原生代币 RITUAL 同步推出并登陆 Coinbase

current_state.zh: Ritual launched its mainnet and native RITUAL token, with Coinbase hosting the token's first exchange listing, backed by a token model where autonomous AI agents pay for inference and compute, validators settle tasks, insiders are locked for a year, and LayerZero handles cross-chain transfers.
